components.html:
Agreed on the same record

The signatures bind the line items, amount, recipient address and blockchain.

narrative.overview: A bilateral trade record rests on a porcelain field beneath cropped Mashrabiya daylight. Plum ink, the bilingual SANAD / سند mark, Lora/Manrope typography, and the interlaced counterseal retain the established identity as Invoices and Wallet become the active destinations.

rules.name: The State-Light Rule
rules.body: Lilac supports pending or selected states; mint supports acknowledgement. Every state also has text or an icon.

rules.name: The Financial-Figure Rule
rules.body: Use tabular, aligned amounts with explicit currency context.

rules.name: The Light-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish depth through daylight and tonal layering before adding functional shadows.

dos: Do preserve the bilingual mark, porcelain/plum world, and interlaced counterseal.
Do keep encryption-key handling separate from record sharing.
Do keep uncertainty and charges beside the action they qualify.
donts: Don't use a signature as evidence of verified identity, wallet ownership, or settlement.
Don't restore historical Chat/Finance composition as active navigation authority.
Don't depict provider information links as integrated checkout or live quotes.
